collection.description: A child makes a rude comment about a sibling during dinner.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) makes a rude comment about (sibling) during dinner.

choices.label: Ask the Child to Reconsider the Words
Let the Sibling Describe the Impact
Pause the Conversation Until Everyone Is Calmer

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) struggles to explain their anger and needs time.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (sibling) admits they had also been teasing earlier.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family resumes dinner peacefully after a short break.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The disagreement continues later but without shouting.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) is not ready to apologize yet, but stops the remarks.
